title: 艺术与传统技艺词汇
goal: 辨认艺术与技艺词汇，准确表达材料和制作过程。

points.label: 选择符合材料和制作过程的表达

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 介绍传统技艺的文字会讲到材料、工具、工序、艺术形式和外观。翻译时分清动作和动作的对象：carve wood 是雕刻木材，weave reeds 是编织芦苇。

body.box:
工匠在木板上雕刻图案，再用刷子涂上颜料。
The craftsperson carves a pattern into a wooden board and then applies pigment with a brush.

body.p: carve 对应雕刻，apply 对应涂抹。木板是雕刻对象，刷子是涂色工具。

body.box:
竹编工匠先把竹子劈成细条，再将竹条交错编成篮子。篮口的边缘经过加固，表面保留了竹子自然的纹理。不同宽度的竹条形成不同的图案。
A bamboo weaver first splits bamboo into narrow strips and then interlaces them to make a basket. The rim is reinforced, and the surface retains the bamboo's natural texture. Strips of different widths create different patterns.

body.p: splits 对应劈开，interlaces 对应交错编织。reinforced 的对象是篮口，texture 指表面的纹理。

body.box:
Which action turns the strips into a basket?
1. Applying pigment to them
2. Interlacing them
3. Polishing them into a rim
4. Cutting patterns into them

body.p: 第二项对应 interlaces them to make a basket。劈成竹条发生在编织之前。

groups.fill: A potter makes a small vessel from clay. The cl{ay} is sha{ped} by ha{nd} before i{t} is le{ft} to d{ry} and th{en} fired i{n} a ki{ln} at hi{gh} temperature. The vessel can then be decorated with pigment. The potter chooses a simple pattern that follows the curve of the surface. After the decoration has been applied, the finished object is ready for use. Each stage changes the material in a different way.
notes: left：be left to dry 表示放置晾干。
in：in a kiln 表示在窑中。

groups.text:
A Printed Design

A printer draws a design on a wooden block. The printer carves away the areas that are not meant to receive ink, leaving the design raised. A roller spreads ink over the raised surface. Paper is placed on the block and pressed against it. When the paper is lifted, the design appears on the sheet. The same block can be inked again to make another print. The carved block is the tool used to transfer the design; the paper is the surface that receives it.

options: The wooden block
The paper sheet
The inked roller
The printed design
items.why: 原文说 carves away the areas，雕刻对象是 wooden block，即第一项。

options: Paper to the carved wooden block
Ink to the raised design on the block
Ink to the areas carved away
Pressure to the paper placed on the block
items.why: 依据是 A roller spreads ink over the raised surface，滚筒把墨涂在凸起的图案上，即第二项。第三项弄反了：刻去的部分不接墨。

options: Removed from the surface of the block
Lifted off the block with the paper
Left higher than the cut-away areas
Covered with ink by the roller
items.why: carves away 和 leaving the design raised 相对照：刻去的是图案以外的部分，图案留得比它们高，即第三项。

options: The ink roller
The wooden block
The raised surface
The paper sheet
items.why: the paper is the surface that receives it 指明纸张承接图案，即第四项。

items.stem: What can be used again to make another print?
options: The lifted sheet
The carved block
The removed wood
The transferred paper
items.why: The same block can be inked again 说明雕好的木版可重复上墨，即第二项。

groups.fill: A craftsperson decorates a piece of cloth. A nee{dle} carries thr{ead} through t{he} fabric a{nd} forms a pat{tern} on i{ts} surface. The des{ign} may inc{lude} flowers o{r} geometric sha{pes}. Different stitches can produce different textures, even when the same color is used throughout. The maker plans the position of each part before beginning. The finished embroidery can decorate clothing or another textile, depending on how the fabric will be used.

groups.text:
A Woven Mat

A workshop makes mats from long plant fibers. The makers first sort the fibers by width and set aside any that are too short for the planned design. They soak the selected fibers in water so that the strips can bend more easily. The strips are then arranged in two directions. The maker passes each strip over and under the strips crossing it, tightening the weave as the mat grows.

Some strips are dyed before weaving. By placing dark and light strips in a chosen sequence, the maker creates a pattern without painting the finished surface. The color belongs to the strips themselves. At the edges, the loose ends are folded back and secured. This step holds the woven structure together; it does not change which fibers form the pattern.

The finished mat has a textured surface because the crossing strips sit at slightly different levels. A wider strip produces a broader band in the design. The workshop can vary the appearance by changing strip widths or colors while using the same basic over-and-under process.

中文信息：工坊把植物纤维浸水后交错编成垫子。部分纤维在编织前染色，深浅条带按顺序形成图案。边缘的松散末端折回并固定。

options: To make their colors darker after weaving
To make the strips easier to bend
To fix the loose ends in place
To paint the finished surface
items.why: soak ... so that the strips can bend more easily 表明浸水使纤维容易弯曲，即第二项。

options: By painting the woven mat after its edges are secured
By sorting fibers after weaving
By arranging dyed strips in sequence
By removing the crossing strips
items.why: placing dark and light strips in a chosen sequence 对应第三项。

items.stem: What does weave mean in this passage?
options: Interlace strips to make a structure
Apply different colors to a finished surface
Soak the loose ends in water
Sort strips by their width
items.why: passes each strip over and under the strips crossing it 描述了交错编织，即第一项。

items.stem: What is done to the loose ends?
options: They are dyed after weaving.
They are cut into wider strips.
They are soaked so that they bend more easily.
They are folded back and secured.
items.why: the loose ends are folded back and secured 对应第四项。

options: Pigment applied after weaving
Crossing strips at different levels
Short fibers removed during sorting
Water retained in the loose ends
items.why: crossing strips sit at slightly different levels 解释了表面纹理，即第二项。
